notes.title: Changes are coming...
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It’s been a while and we have been hard at work with Fovos VR, while also working on our next game! We have received plenty of feedback, we have read all your comments, good and bad and we thank you all for that. We are in the process of reworking most aspects of the game and we are expecting to release an update in the near future (~1 month) that will incorporate all these changes. Here’s a short list of them:

[list]
[*]New Weapons! More guns was one of the most requested items and so we deliver! Expect a shotgun, an assault rifle and a revamped pistol.
[*]Enemy models are being recreated from the ground up. More attacks, more animations, more enemy types, more tactics, more, more, more!
[*]Environments! Shiny (well, dusty) new places for you to chase and be chased around? Did we mention movement? That’s true! ;)
[/list]

But of course, we did not come empty handed, so here’s some teasers for you to enjoy until the update arrives!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27357239/977bad9cd0498ae5c394fae3f0aae45b00e53135.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27357239/59ad8b44feb85194befc9cffbbfe1c3f2665b7e7.png[/img]

notes.title: FovosVR Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Just a small set of fixes, we are working on refining the enemies, rebuilding them from the ground up to be more aggressive, smart and have more animations. Stay tuned for that.

Here is a list of [b][i]changes[/i][/b]:
[list]
[*] Added visible sights to the gun.
[*] Fixed a bug where the gun and laser would sometimes collide with invisible objects.
[*]Slightly changed gun position.
[*]Raised seated position in driving scene.
[/list]

Once again, thank you for trying the game out, we are open to your comments and recommendations.

notes.title: FovosVR Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
During these last few days we received some (mostly) helpful comments and suggestions and made some changes to the game, mostly corrections and adjustments, while we are still working on improving the overall gameplay experience and survival mode.

Here is a list of [b][i]changes[/i][/b]:
[list]
[*]Improvements on the collision detection of the gun on lower frame-rates.
[*]Added an options menu for changing graphic presets and volumes (left controller menu button).
[*]Reduced the duration of the first story sequence, people seems to stop playing before they reached the rest.
[*]Added a way to skip the car intro sequence.
[*]Added/Improved some tutorial instructions.
[*]Lowered grass movement to prevent nausea when playing while closer to the ground (sitting down, etc...).
[*]Reduced zombie range, zombies now get closer to the player for a better effect.
[/list]

Thank you for trying the game out, please continue to give us your comments/recommendations.
